messages.subject: Microclima error with runauto
messages.body_plain:
Hi Mike and others,

I have been trying to test run some functions in microclima, however even just using the example data from the vignette

r <- get_dem(lat = 38.467429, long = -28.398995, resolution = 30) temps <- runauto(r, "10/06/2010", "15/06/2010", hgt = 0.1, l = NA, x = NA, habitat = "Barren or sparsely vegetated")

Everything seems to run fine, downloading the data etc, but I keep getting the same error below
running microclimate model for 6 days from 2010-06-10 to 2010-06-15 23:00:00 at site long -28.398995 lat 38.467429 user system elapsed 0.25 0.00 0.28  Paramaterising model using NicheMapR Calculating wind shelter coefficients Running model in hourly time-steps Error in tout[, , i] <- xx : number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length In addition: Warning messages: 1: package ‘sp’ was built under R version 4.3.3 2: package ‘RNCEP’ was built under R version 4.3.3 3: package ‘RNetCDF’ was built under R version 4.3.3 4: In microclima::microclimaforNMR(lat = longlat[2], long = longlat[1], : Data sequence in UTC/GMT. Some or all dates using system timezone are in AWST

I have made sure that I am using the latest versions of microclima and NicheMapR from github, so not sure
what might be the cause here.

Cheers
Leanne

messages.subject: Re: Microclima error with runauto
messages.body_plain:
Hi Leanne,

This is a question for Ilya I think. I ran your code and got a nice plot of a volcano. But I can see the part of the runauto function that fails is the bit pasted below. One way you could try and check what's going on is by stepping through runauto line by line and see what's going wrong at the point below.

if (hgt < 0) { soil0 <- is_raster(tea) + tr heatdown <- soil0 - tout[, , i] heatup <- mean(soiltemps$D200cm) - tout[, , i] xx <- tout[, , i] + dfsoil$x1 * heatdown + dfsoil$x2 * heatup if (save.memory) xx <- round(xx * 1000, 0) tout[, , i + 1] <- xx } else { xx <- is_raster(tr) + is_raster(tea) if (save.memory) xx <- round(xx * 1000, 0) tout[, , i] <- xx }

All the best,
Mike

messages.subject: two new micro functions including a forecast function
messages.subject_clean: two new micro functions including a forecast function
messages.body_plain:
Dear NicheMapR users,

A couple of new functions are available that you might find useful:

1) 'micro_openmeteo' which links to the Open-Meteo <https://open-meteo.com/> weather service, with 80 years of historical weather data for the globe plus a 14-day forecasts (it by default runs the forecast plus the past year as a spin-up);

2) 'micro_silo' which runs from the SILO  <https://www.longpaddock.qld.gov.au/silo/>Australian historical weather dataset, from 1889 to yesterday.

They both link directly to the data via the web - micro_silo needs an email address to be included as an argument to the function but micro_openmeteo doesn't.

Please let me know if you encounter any bugs with them - they aren't fully road-tested.

All the best,
Mike
